change_summary: oya-regional-pack-domain: add kr_regulatory module with PipaDataClassification enum (Art-23 sensitive-data categories including RaceOrEthnicity) and KrRegulatoryBinding struct (CSAP evidence ref). M04-P02-IP-001 merge-variant delta-1; no new crate scaffolding.

findings: Eliminated the special-case of callers having to encode PIPA Art-23 sensitive-data categories as raw strings with no type safety. The enum variant set exactly matches the statutory enumeration — no extras, no guesswork.
KrRegulatoryBinding constructor enforces the oya-pack- prefix invariant already established by RegionalPack::new, keeping both types consistent without duplication.
No new crate, no new workspace dep, no new Cargo.toml file. The change is one new Rust module added to an existing crate — minimal blast radius.
RaceOrEthnicity variant added after P1 review: prevents callers from misclassifying Art-23 race/ethnicity data as General.
Pure value types (enum + struct) with no IO, no allocations beyond String fields in KrRegulatoryBinding. Zero runtime overhead on the hot path.
statutory_label() returns &'static str — no heap allocation, branch-predictor-friendly exhaustive match.
Enum derives Copy + Clone: zero-cost to pass by value across domain boundaries; no Arc/Rc needed.
No async, no network, no file I/O in this module. Horizontal scalability is unconstrained — all state is caller-owned.
Rejection test for non-oya-pack- prefix: asserts InvalidPackId. Mirrors the same guard in RegionalPack::new.
Rejection test for blank csap_evidence_ref: asserts EmptyCsapEvidenceRef. Blank/whitespace-only string rejected.
is_sensitive() exhaustively tested: General is not sensitive, all 7 Art-23 variants (including RaceOrEthnicity) are sensitive.
statutory_label() exhaustively tested: all 8 variants return non-empty Korean strings.
Synthetic-violation test race_or_ethnicity_is_sensitive_with_canonical_label: proves RaceOrEthnicity maps to 인종·민족 and is marked sensitive — catches any future regression on this P1 fix.
Enum variants use English names matching the PIPA English-language translation (IdeologyOrBelief, RaceOrEthnicity) so callers need no Korean reading ability to select the correct variant.
statutory_label() provides the canonical Korean output for audit/consent text generation, separating classification (Rust type) from presentation (string).
KrRegulatoryBinding::new() returns Result with typed error variants — callers get actionable error discrimination without string parsing.
All types derive Debug: usable in assert! / expect! messages without boilerplate.
12/12 tests pass after P1 fixes (cargo nextest). No test skipped.
rustfmt 1.95.0 clean — no formatting deviations.
ADR-0083 Tier 3 cfg(test) exemption applied for unwrap/expect/panic in test code only.
No clippy warnings in modified file (non-test path has no unwrap/expect/panic).
Exhaustive match on PipaDataClassification — compiler enforces coverage when new variants are added.
Alternative considered: raw string constants instead of enum. Rejected — no compiler-enforced exhaustiveness, typo risk, no is_sensitive() method without a lookup table.
Alternative considered: separate crate for KR regulatory types. Rejected — merge-variant delta-1 strategy mandates no new crate scaffolding; the domain crate is the correct home.

Alternative considered: combining BiometricOrGenetic and RaceOrEthnicity into a single 'SensitiveBiometric' variant. Rejected — PIPA Art-23 treats these as distinct categories with different consent bases; collapsing them produces incorrect audit labeling.
Chosen approach (enum in existing domain crate) is the minimum viable change with maximum type safety.
No secrets, credentials, or PII in the production code. Enum variants and struct fields are classification metadata only.
KrRegulatoryBinding enforces non-empty csap_evidence_ref at construction — prevents silent null/blank evidence references from passing downstream admission checks.
The RaceOrEthnicity variant ensures race/ethnicity data cannot be accidentally classified as General and bypass Art-23 consent requirements.
No unsafe code. No external crate dependencies introduced. Attack surface unchanged.
PipaDataClassification: PIPA is the statute acronym (개인정보 보호법); DataClassification is the domain noun. Conforms to v4 BNF: <Acronym><DomainNoun> in UpperCamelCase.
KrRegulatoryBinding: Kr = ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 prefix (per ADR-0049 KR-pack pattern); RegulatoryBinding is the domain noun. Consistent with RegionalPack naming in this crate.
Module name kr_regulatory: snake_case, matches crate file-naming convention observed across oya-* crates.
Error enum variants InvalidPackId / EmptyCsapEvidenceRef: match the existing RegionalPackError variant style (adjective + noun).
RaceOrEthnicity: follows same compound-noun pattern as IdeologyOrBelief, UnionOrPartyMembership.
No new inter-crate dependencies introduced. oya-regional-pack-domain already depends on oya-data-boundary-kernel and oya-residency-domain; kr_regulatory.rs uses neither (pure domain types only).
Domain-layer placement is correct: PipaDataClassification and KrRegulatoryBinding are pure value types with no IO, no storage, no network — appropriate for a -domain crate.
The module is pub with re-exports at the crate root, following the same pattern as the existing RegionalPack / RegionalPackError types.
Inward-only flow respected: the new types do not import from any layer above domain.

council_verdict.rationale: All 9 facets (F1-F7/A1/A3) green. P1 fixes applied: RaceOrEthnicity variant added, git_sha updated to a6c64334, F2/F4/F5/F6/F7 facets populated. 12/12 tests pass. No new deps, no new crate.
